mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also increase by more than 2% YoY, it signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (HOUST YoY > 5% and RSAFS YoY > 2%) does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in a quarter and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY is above 2%, it signals tightening monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (FEDFUNDS QoQ > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%) does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS growth does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) also increases by more than 2% YoY, it signals a strong supply side and robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (INDPRO YoY > 2% and GDPC1 YoY > 2%) does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
